build_cli_argument_list: build a CLI argument list from a config dictionary merged with sys.argv for SimulEval
check_argument_value: check the value of a named argument from SimulEval's general argparse parser
run_config_dict_to_args: run a config dictionary and convert it to CLI-style argument strings for SimulEval
test_argument_parsing: test argument parsing by checking a specific argument name from SimulEval CLI
review_cli_argument_merge: review how cli_argument_list merges config dict values with existing sys.argv arguments
